name: Arch Linux Firefox Compiler Env
onCreateCommand: useradd -m -s /bin/bash vscode && echo 'vscode ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' >> /etc/sudoers && echo 'Server=https://archive.archlinux.org/repos/2026/08/04/$repo/os/$arch' > /etc/pacman.d/mirrorlist && pacman -Syy --noconfirm && pacman -S --noconfirm base-devel git sudo shadow
postCreateCommand: echo 'MAKEFLAGS="-j2"' >> /etc/makepkg.conf && echo 'COMPRESSXZ=(xz -c -z --threads=2 -)' >> /etc/makepkg.conf && dd if=/dev/zero of=/tmp/swapfile bs=1M count=4096 && chmod 600 /tmp/swapfile && mkswap /tmp/swapfile
